```{r Packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(rstan)
library(truncnorm)
```

```{r Prep_Data}
paramecium_data <- read_csv("data/sdm_data.csv") |>
  select(particles = avg_particles,
         well,
         experiment,
         timestep,
         conc = conc_correct,
         temp = mean_temp_all) |>
  mutate(well = paste0(well,experiment)) |>
  # First value for well 40sdm3 is 0, which breaks model - remove
  filter_out(well == "40sdm3") |>
  mutate(well = as.numeric(fct(as.character(well))))

paramecium_counts <- paramecium_data |>
  select(particles, well, timestep, conc, temp) |>
  filter_out(is.na(particles)) |>
  filter_out(timestep == 0)

n0_vals <- paramecium_data |>
  select(particles, well, timestep) |>
  filter_out(is.na(particles)) |>
  filter(timestep == 0) |>
  pull(particles)

well_details <- paramecium_data |>
  select(well, conc, temp) |>
  distinct()


model_data <- list(particles = paramecium_counts$particles+1.001,
                   n0 = n0_vals,
                   temp = well_details$temp,
                   conc = well_details$conc,
                   timestep = paramecium_counts$timestep,
                   well_i = paramecium_counts$well,
                   well = nrow(well_details),
                   N_obs = nrow(paramecium_counts))
```

```{r Model}
growthModel <- "
  data {
    int<lower=1> N_obs;
    int<lower=1> well;
    vector[well] conc;
    vector[well] temp;
    array[N_obs] int<lower=1> well_i;
    array[N_obs] int<lower=1> timestep;
    vector<lower=1>[N_obs] particles;
    vector<lower=1>[well] n0;
  }
  
  transformed data {
    vector[well] temp_norm = temp-24;
  }
  
  parameters {
    vector<lower=0.00001, upper = 1000000>[well] K;
    vector<lower=0, upper = 10>[well] r;
    real<lower=0.001, upper = 10> sigma_k;
    real<lower=0.001, upper = 5> sd_r;
    real<lower=0.001, upper = 10> sigma_particles;
    real<lower=0,upper = 10> a_r;
    real<lower=5,upper = 20> b_conc;
    real<lower=-10,upper=10> b_temp;
    real<lower=-10,upper=10> b_temp2;
  }
  
  transformed parameters {
    vector<lower=1.00001,upper=1000000>[well] k_mu = (exp(b_conc*conc));
    vector<lower=-10000,upper=10000>[well] r_mu = a_r+(b_temp*temp_norm)+(b_temp2*(temp_norm^2));
  }
  
  model {
    vector[N_obs] mu_particles;
    // Priors
    sigma_k ~ exponential(1) T[0.0001,];
    sd_r ~ exponential(1) T[0.0001,];
    sigma_particles ~ exponential(1) T[0.0001,];
    a_r ~ exponential(1) T[0.0001,];
    b_conc ~ normal(12, 6) T[5,20];
    b_temp ~ normal(0, 2.5);
    b_temp2 ~ normal(0, 2.5);
    
    // Carrying capacity/growth rate
    for (j in 1:well){
      K[j] ~ lognormal(log(k_mu[j]), sigma_k) T[0.0001,];
      r[j] ~ normal(r_mu[j], sd_r) T[0,];
    }
    
    for (i in 1:N_obs){
      mu_particles[i] = K[well_i[i]]/(1+((K[well_i[i]]-n0[well_i[i]])/n0[well_i[i]])*exp(-1*r[well_i[i]]*timestep[i]));
    }

    // Particles by timestep
    particles ~ lognormal(log(mu_particles+1.001), sigma_particles);
    
  }
"
```

```{r PriorChecks}
# Concentration response
data.frame(b_conc = rtruncnorm(1000, 5, 20, mean = 12, sd = 3)) |>
  filter(b_conc >= 1) |>
  mutate(conc = 0) |>
  mutate(group = as.character(1:n())) |>
  complete(nesting(b_conc, group), 
           conc = seq(0, 0.5, by = 0.01)) |>
  mutate(k = exp(b_conc*conc)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = conc, y = k, group = group)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.1)


# Temperature response
temp <- data.frame(a_r = rexp(1000, 1),
                   b_temp = rnorm(1000, 0, 2.5),
                   b_temp2 = rnorm(1000, 0, 2.5),
                   temp = 0) |>
  mutate(group = as.character(1:n())) |>
  complete(nesting(a_r, b_temp, b_temp2, group), 
           temp = seq(-5, 5, by = 0.1)) |>
  mutate(r = a_r+(b_temp*temp)+(b_temp2*(temp^2))) |>
  mutate(r = if_else(r < 0, 0, r))
temp_med <- temp |>
  summarise(r = median(r),.by=temp)

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = temp, aes(x = temp, y = r, group = group), alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(data = temp_med, aes(x = temp,y=r), colour = "cyan") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), colour = "orange")+
  ylim(c(0, 5))

```

```{r InitsFunction}
makeInits <- function(model_data){
  
  
  outList <- list(sigma_particles = 0.1,
                  sd_r = 0.5, 
                  a_r = 1, 
                  b_conc = 12,
                  b_temp = -.01,
                  b_temp2 = -.01,
                  sigma_k = 0.1)
  
  simData <- data.frame(well = 1:model_data$well,
                        temp = model_data$temp-24,
                        conc = model_data$conc) |>
    mutate(K = (exp(conc*outList$b_conc)),
           r = outList$a_r +
             (outList$b_temp*temp) +
             (outList$b_temp2*(temp^2))) |>
    mutate(r = if_else(r < 0, 0, r))
  
  simParticles <- simData |>
    mutate(n0 = model_data$n0) |>
    mutate(timestep = 1) |>
    complete(nesting(n0, r, K, temp, conc),
             timestep = 1:86) |>
    mutate(mu_particles = (K*n0*exp(r*timestep))/(K+(n0*(exp(r*timestep)-1))))
    
  
  outList$r <- simData$r
  outList$K <- simData$K
  outList$r_mu <- simData$r
  outList$k_mu <- simData$K
  return(outList)
}

```

```{r RunModel}
growthModel_fit <- stan(
  model_code = growthModel,
  data = model_data,
  init = list(makeInits(model_data),
              makeInits(model_data),
              makeInits(model_data),
              makeInits(model_data)),
  chains = 4,
  warmup = 1000,
  iter = 2000,
  cores = 4,
  refresh = 500
)
  
  
write_rds(growthModel_fit, "outputs/stan_model.rds")
```
